# Sureword

> Frontline healthcare voice documentation platform with selective spoken clarification.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://krishujeniya.github.io/MostlyOutlier/
> Live Site: https://krishujeniya.github.io/Sureword/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/Sureword

## Overview
Sureword empowers frontline community health workers (ASHAs/ANMs) across rural and urban India to complete clinical encounter intake entirely via natural speech in 11 Indic languages, with automated slot extraction and selective targeted clarification.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Canonical Person Entity: https://krishujeniya.github.io/#krishujeniya
- Linked Projects: AGYOS, Hadron, WaferPulse, Somnostasis, Curavex, Hajree, Scanlark, TraceMigo

## Key Architecture & Features
- Multilingual Speech Pipeline: Gnani.ai Prisma ASR / Timbre TTS supporting Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, and English.
- Selective Clarification Engine: Statistical entropy analysis identifying missing or ambiguous clinical entities and generating minimal spoken follow-up prompts.
- Offline Resilience: Local audio buffering and schema-validated JSON payload synchronization.
